name: fireflies-ai
label: Fireflies.ai
description: Meeting assistant that automatically records, transcribes, and analyzes conversations

token.label: API Key
token.description:
To use Fireflies.ai, you need to get an API key:
1. Login to your account at https://fireflies.ai.
2. Navigate to Settings > Developer Settings in the left sidebar.
3. Copy the API key from the API Key section.

find-meeting-by-id.label: Find Meeting by ID
find-meeting-by-id.description: Finds a specific meeting by ID.

meetingId.label: Meeting ID
meetingId.description: The ID of the meeting to retrieve.

body.query:
query Transcript($transcriptId: String!) 
    {
		transcript(id: $transcriptId) 
        {
			id
			dateString
			privacy
			speakers 
            {
                id
                name
			}
			title
			host_email
			organizer_email
			calendar_id
			user 
            {
                user_id
                email
                name
                num_transcripts
                recent_meeting
                minutes_consumed
                is_admin
                integrations
			}
			fireflies_users
			participants
			date
			transcript_url
			audio_url
			video_url
			duration
			meeting_attendees 
            {
                displayName
                email
                phoneNumber
                name
                location
			}
			summary 
            {
                keywords
                action_items
                outline
                shorthand_bullet
                overview
                bullet_gist
                gist
                short_summary
                short_overview
                meeting_type
                topics_discussed
                transcript_chapters
			}
			cal_id
			calendar_type
			meeting_info 
            {
                fred_joined
                silent_meeting
                summary_status
			}
			meeting_link
		}
	}

find_recent_meeting.label: Find Recent Meeting
find_recent_meeting.description: Retrieves the latest meeting for a user.

body.query:
query User
				{
					user
					{
						user_id
						recent_transcript
						recent_meeting
						num_transcripts
						name
						minutes_consumed
						is_admin
						integrations
						email
					}
				}

upload_audio.label: Upload Audio
upload_audio.description: Creates a new meeeting in Fireflies for transcription (requires a publicly accessible URL).

audioUrl.label: Audio URL
audioUrl.description: The publicly accessible URL to your audio file (mp3, mp4, wav, m4a, ogg). Fireflies API only accepts URLs, not direct file uploads. For private files, consider using signed URLs with short expiry times.
